title: Formal Proof for a Constant Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Prove using the epsilon-delta definition that lim_{x -> c} k = k for any real constant k.

steps.title: Evaluate the Output Distance
steps.explanation: Since the function value is identically k for all x, the distance to L = k is zero.
steps.why: A constant function produces the exact same output for all inputs.

steps.title: Conclude for Any Positive Delta
steps.explanation: Since |f(x) - L| = 0 is less than any positive epsilon, any positive delta satisfies the condition.
steps.why: Zero is strictly less than every positive real number epsilon.
